entities.name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
entities.description: Legendary artifact human from Esper, Alara, who created Armix and replaced most of her body with etherium.

entities.name: Armix
entities.description: Experimental golem of new etherium, loyal but brutal and reckless.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara driven by the Noble Work.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane of the shards, reunited during the Conflux.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard where Breya rediscovered carmot and sangrite.

entities.name: Noble Work
entities.description: Esperite effort to augment all living things with etherium.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event reuniting the shards of Alara.

events.summary: Exploring Jund, Breya rediscovers carmot and sangrite, proving etherium supply is not finite.
Breya creates Armix, an experimental golem of new etherium.
events.quote: she created Armix , an experimental golem made entirely of brand-new etherium

events.summary: Breya replaces most of her organic body with etherium and gains new abilities from Jund's wild magic.
events.quote: She replaced the majority of her organic body with etherium she created herself.
